A top-down RPG character walk-cycle sprite sheet, RPG-Maker-charset convention, laid out as a precise grid with THIN SOLID MAGENTA (#FF00FF) DIVIDER LINES, 2px wide, separating every row and every column, clearly visible so the grid can be sliced mechanically. Every cell's background must be flat, solid, pure CHROMA-KEY GREEN (#00FF00), completely uniform, with a crisp hard edge against the character and no blended halo. Grid: 4 rows x 3 columns, every cell exactly the same size. CRITICAL, in every cell without exception: the character is a FULL BODY figure, head down to feet, feet clearly visible, filling nearly the full cell height — NEVER a bust, NEVER cropped at the waist or hip. Character centred, identical scale in every cell. RPG-Maker 3-frame walk cycle per row: Column 2 (the MIDDLE one) = a true NEUTRAL STANDING pose, legs straight and together, arms relaxed — exactly what the character looks like standing still. Column 1 = mid-step, left leg forward, weight shifted, opposite arm swung. Column 3 = mid-step, right leg forward, the exact mirror of column 1. Row 1 (top) = facing DOWN toward the viewer. Row 2 = facing LEFT in TRUE SIDE PROFILE — seen from the side, nose pointing left, one shoulder toward the viewer, NOT a front-facing pose turned slightly, and the legs must clearly stride past each other in columns 1 and 3. Row 3 = facing RIGHT in true side profile, the exact mirror of row 2. Row 4 (bottom) = facing UP, back view — even from behind it is a full standing body: head with hair, shoulders, torso, legs, visible feet, NOT a shapeless blob of hair. The character: {CHARACTER}. Use any reference image ONLY for design and colour likeness, never for pose or crop. Nothing else in the image: no text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no scenery.
